name: Knock and Run: 100 Doors Escape 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Knock and Run: 100 Doors Escape is a fast-paced, casual arcade game where you race through hotel corridors, ringing doorbells and pulling off hilarious pranks. But be careful: residents react unpredictably, and trouble is always around the corner.
